messages:
Priya (AE): Quick note — Prospect Bridgewater Investments wants an RFP response + a short POC. Key asks: EU-only data plane, HSM/BYOK, embeddings retention policy = 0, and a fixed POC cap. They asked for the capability matrix + POC quote by Friday. Can we align? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the POC scope: 2-week smoke + 2-week performance. Goals: connectivity, sample inference accuracy, 99th pctl latency under 120ms. Need to confirm sample dataset size and redaction rules.
Keiko (Security): For embeddings retention = 0 we can enable no-persist mode; note that ephemeral caches could still hold transient states until container restart. Also we'll need an NDA addendum for crypto escrow if they insist on KMS visibility. I'll attach the checklist.
Mateo (Eng): HSM note: private deploy supports AWS CloudHSM and Vault HSM via PKCS#11. For EU-only, we can deploy to eu-west-1 region. For dedup/embeddings pipeline, we'll add a TTL=0 flag to the vector store to prevent writes. We'll need infra lead time ~5 business days.
Noah (Finance): On the POC cap — we can quote a fixed daily rate + an overage soft cap. For two A100-equivalent nodes for 4 weeks rough estimate = $XX,XXX. If they want a true capped spend contract we'd need prepayment and legal sign-off.
Priya (AE): @Noah can you provide a line-item with day rates and a one-time setup? I'll present to customer.
Sam (Solutions): Draft capability matrix columns I'll use: feature, supported, default behavior, POC config, mitigation notes, risk level. Will mark embeddings retention and HSM specifics.
Keiko (Security): Also: they requested pentest report and supply chain questions. We have a recent pen test summary (redacted) and a supplier risk doc. I'll upload both and fill the SQQ (security questionnaire).
deploy-bot: Uploaded: bridgewater_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx
Sam (Solutions): Adding a tiny Terraform snippet for private deployment VPN peer (for their infra team):
```
provider "aws" { region = "eu-west-1" }
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "redwood_peer" {
  vpc_id = "vpc-0aa1bb2c"
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-0cc2dd3e"
}
```
Mateo (Eng): Also sample smoke curl for their infra team once tunnel is up:
```
curl -X POST https://private.eu.redwood.example/v1/chat \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFX" \\
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize trade blotter"}] }'
```
Priya (AE): Timeline check: Draft matrix + SQQ answers by Thu EOD, POC budget by Thu noon, legal/terms by Fri. Can the security pentest push extend the POC by 2 weeks? Customer hinted they'd accept.
Keiko (Security): If they require an external pentest we should assume +10 business days. I'll add a note in the matrix under risks.
Noah (Finance): I'll produce a conservative budget today and an alternate "expedited" price if they accept limited logs and shorter PT scope.
Sam (Solutions): Sending a short list of success criteria to include in the POC acceptance: 1) connectivity + auth ok, 2) latency within SLO, 3) embeddings retention verified = 0, 4) inference correctness on sample prompts.
Priya (AE): Perfect. Please add all artifacts to the shared folder. I'll compile and send to the buyer Friday morning. :email:
deploy-bot: Uploaded: security_questionnaire_filled_bridgewater_v1.pdf
Mateo (Eng): One more ops caveat — if they want full log blackout we should include debug escalation policy in contract so we can enable transient diagnostics under mutual approval.
Priya (AE): Good call. Thanks team — assigning reviews.
